verdict.rationale: Docs describe card transactions as automatically 'controlled, categorized, and automatically compliant' and support real-time webhook event notifications for S&E events, implying transactions are visible/categorized as they occur rather than only on statements. However, there is no direct evidence of a dashboard or reporting view that breaks down spend specifically by team, category, and merchant in real time. Missing for 10: explicit dashboard/reporting UI screenshots or docs showing team/category/merchant breakdowns, independent user corroboration of real-time visibility.
